author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Gothic 1 Remake, the classic action-adventure RPG developed by Alkimia Interactive. Players will explore and brave the Valley of Mines as the Nameless Hero. Engage in deep third-person action combat with a variety of weapons fitted with modern features, including improved visuals, performance, and more. Gothic 1 Remake is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Gothic 1 Remake - Official Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the latest X4: Foundations trailer for this single-player space simulation game, where players can pilot ships, build stations, and lead vast fleets in a fully simulated sandbox universe with rich lore and storylines. The latest X4: Foundations gives a breakdown of what you can expect from The Empire update, which redefines how you fight and command, with ships and weapons rebalancing, priority orders, and more. X4: Foundations is available on PC. The Empire update for X4: Foundations will be available on June 10, 2026.
title: X4: Foundations - Official The Empire Update Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description:
After 25 years, Gothic is back with the release of Gothic 1 Remake. The classic RPG has been rebuilt from the ground up for modern consoles thanks to the implementation of current-gen graphics, all while preserving the gameplay that makes Gothic 1 a classic. If you’re new to the series or it’s been a while since your own visit to the Valley of the Mines, here are 6 things you need to know, including: the story of Gothic 1, its unique gameplay mechanics, similarities and differences between the original Gothic, and more.
Presented by THQ Nordic.
title: Gothic 1 Remake - 6 Things You Need to Know

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Red Band Trailer for Ice Cream Man, an upcoming horror film distributed by The Horror Selection. Witness a complete meltdown in Ice Cream Man, in theaters on August 7.

An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results. 

Ice Cream Man stars Ari Millen, Benjamin Byron Davis, Eli Roth, Karen Cliche, Dylan Hawco, Sarah Abbott, Shiloh O’Reilly, Kiori Mirza Waldman, Charlie Zeltzer, and Charlie Storey. The film is directed and produced by Eli Roth, alongside being co-written by longtime collaborator Noah Belson and Eli Roth.

Ice Cream Man is in theaters on August 7.
title: Ice Cream Man - Official Red Band Trailer (2026) Ari Millen, Benjamin Byron Davis, Eli Roth

author: IGN
description: Check out ten minutes of in-depth gameplay provided by the development team for the 3.0 version of Zenless Zone Zero. This gameplay shows off Roscaelifer’s rich environmental ecology and new interactive elements, including a new Skybus transit system, a more intricate exploration experience, and expanded Bangboo gameplay mechanics. Additionally, you'll also see a brand-new combat experience featuring the gameplay of Pyrois (the long-awaited combat avatar of Phaethon), alongside new Agents Velina (ZZZ's very first Wind-attribute Agent) and Norma.
title: Zenless Zone Zero 3.0: 10 Minutes of Deep-Dive Gameplay
